component.name: CHAT CHANNEL GATEWAY (SYSTEM, READ-ONLY)
component.description:
What it does Sends one message to a Telegram chat, a Slack or Discord channel, or a Microsoft Teams channel, from any point in an orchestration - a build result, an alert, a summary for the team.

How it works The message is written once in the Inspector. Anything in ${braces} is filled in from the data arriving at the node, so "Nightly load finished: ${row_count} rows" reads as the real number. The send goes through the platform's alert service and the organization's approved outbound routes; the platform credential stays an organization secret and is never written into the template. If the message does not arrive, the run fails - it is never reported as sent.

Configure
- Platform - telegram, slack, discord or teams.
- Recipient - the chat id (Telegram), channel id (Slack, Discord) or webhook URL (Teams).
- Message - the body; ${field} placeholders are filled from incoming data.
- Title, Action Button URL and Label - an optional header and link button.
- Severity - info (default), warning or critical.
- Enabled - turn it off to keep the node in place without sending anything.
- Platform Credentials - bind the organization secret holding the bot token or webhook credential.

In and out In: any data; its fields fill the placeholders, and an optional fields object is shown as key/value pairs under the message. Out: the channel, the status (sent or skipped), the platform's delivery id and status, and a reason when skipped.

Use it when
- A run should tell people it finished, or that something needs attention.
- An agent needs a tool it can call to post a message.
- You want a notification step you can switch off without rewiring the canvas.

component.manifest_yaml:
extension_type: tool
name: Chat Channel Gateway
description: >
  Sends one message to Telegram, Slack, Discord or Microsoft Teams through
  perceivo.alerts.send_direct. ${field} placeholders in the message, title and
  action URL are filled from request_data. A failed dispatch raises and fails
  the run; the Enabled switch turns the node into a no-op that reports skipped.

input_ports:
  - port_name: input
    port_type: in
    # A TOOL reached by an INVOKE edge. It neither reads nor emits an artifact,
    # and an INVOKE edge is checked in both directions, so both halves are none.
    artifact_type_input: none
    artifact_type_output: none
    # Placeholders read request_data by whatever name the message names, so no
    # specific inbound key is required. `fields` is the only key read by name.
    request_data:
      fields: object (optional) - Key/value pairs rendered under the message.
    response_data:
      channel: string - The platform the message was sent to.
      status: string - sent, or skipped when the node is disabled. A failure raises instead.
      delivery_id: string - The platform's delivery id; empty when skipped.
      platform_status: string - The status the platform returned; empty when skipped.
      reason: string - Why nothing was sent (channel_disabled); empty when sent.

required_secrets:
  - name: credentials
    label: Platform Credentials
    required: true
    description: Bot token (Telegram, Slack, Discord) or webhook credential (Teams) for the chosen platform.

input_parameters:
  - name: platform
    type: select
    label: Platform
    options: [telegram, slack, discord, teams]
    required: true
  - name: recipient
    type: text
    label: Recipient
    required: true
    description: Chat id (Telegram), channel id (Slack, Discord) or webhook URL (Teams).
  - name: message
    type: text_long
    label: Message
    required: true
    description: Message body. ${field} is replaced with that field from request_data.
  - name: title
    type: text
    label: Title
    description: Optional bold header. Accepts ${field} placeholders.
  - name: action_url
    type: text
    label: Action Button URL
    description: Optional button link. Accepts ${field} placeholders.
  - name: action_label
    type: text
    label: Action Button Label
    default: Open
  - name: severity
    type: select
    label: Severity
    options: [info, warning, critical]
    default: info
  - name: enabled
    type: boolean
    label: Enabled
    default: true
    required: false
    description: When off, nothing is sent and the node reports status skipped.

fields.description: Key/value pairs rendered under the message.

channel.description: The platform the message was sent to.

status.description: sent, or skipped when the node is disabled. A failure raises instead.

delivery_id.description: The platform's delivery id; empty when skipped.

platform_status.description: The status the platform returned; empty when skipped.

reason.description: Why nothing was sent (channel_disabled); empty when sent.
